configurations.name: livestock-frontend

configurations.name: livestock-backend
runtimeArgs: docker network create livestock-preview-net >/dev/null 2>&1; docker rm -f livestock-preview-pg >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --rm --name livestock-preview-pg --network livestock-preview-net -e POSTGRES_USER=mastplaner -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=mastplaner -e POSTGRES_DB=mastplaner postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null; trap 'docker rm -f livestock-preview-pg >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT; until docker exec livestock-preview-pg pg_isready -U mastplaner >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; docker run --rm --network livestock-preview-net -p 8010:8000 -v /home/martinz/git/fmis/modules/livestock:/workspace -w /workspace/backend -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://mastplaner:mastplaner@livestock-preview-pg:5432/mastplaner -e JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-local-preview -e INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL=dev@example.com -e PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:5173 -e TEST_LOGIN_PASSWORD=devtest123 python:3.12-slim sh -c "pip install --quiet -e . && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
